business_calendar_years_validated_chk.name: business_calendar_years_validated_chk
business_calendar_years_validated_chk.value: "business_calendar_years"."status" = 'DRAFT' OR ("business_calendar_years"."validated_by" IS NOT NULL AND "business_calendar_years"."validated_at" IS NOT NULL AND "business_calendar_years"."national_checked" AND "business_calendar_years"."state_checked" AND "business_calendar_years"."municipal_checked")

delivery_checklist_template_revisions_pu.name: delivery_checklist_template_revisions_published_chk
delivery_checklist_template_revisions_pu.value: ("delivery_checklist_template_revisions"."status" = 'RASCUNHO' AND "delivery_checklist_template_revisions"."published_at" IS NULL) OR ("delivery_checklist_template_revisions"."status" = 'PUBLICADA' AND "delivery_checklist_template_revisions"."published_at" IS NOT NULL)

project_delivery_version_items_evidence_.name: project_delivery_version_items_evidence_chk
project_delivery_version_items_evidence_.value: ("project_delivery_version_items"."evidence_ref" IS NULL AND "project_delivery_version_items"."evidence_kind" IS NULL) OR ("project_delivery_version_items"."evidence_ref" IS NOT NULL AND "project_delivery_version_items"."evidence_kind" IS NOT NULL AND char_length(btrim("project_delivery_version_items"."evidence_ref")) BETWEEN 1 AND 1000)

project_delivery_version_items_decision_.name: project_delivery_version_items_decision_chk
project_delivery_version_items_decision_.value:
(
        ("project_delivery_version_items"."status" = 'PENDENTE' AND "project_delivery_version_items"."evidence_ref" IS NULL AND "project_delivery_version_items"."submitted_by" IS NULL AND "project_delivery_version_items"."submitted_at" IS NULL AND "project_delivery_version_items"."decided_by" IS NULL AND "project_delivery_version_items"."decided_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("project_delivery_version_items"."status" = 'ENVIADO' AND "project_delivery_version_items"."evidence_ref" IS NOT NULL AND "project_delivery_version_items"."submitted_by" IS NOT NULL AND "project_delivery_version_items"."submitted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "project_delivery_version_items"."decided_by" IS NULL AND "project_delivery_version_items"."decided_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("project_delivery_version_items"."status" = 'APROVADO' AND "project_delivery_version_items"."evidence_ref" IS NOT NULL AND "project_delivery_version_items"."submitted_by" IS NOT NULL AND "project_delivery_version_items"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL AND "project_delivery_version_items"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL AND "project_delivery_version_items"."decided_by" <> "project_delivery_version_items"."submitted_by")
        OR ("project_delivery_version_items"."status" = 'REJEITADO' AND "project_delivery_version_items"."evidence_ref" IS NOT NULL AND "project_delivery_version_items"."submitted_by" IS NOT NULL AND "project_delivery_version_items"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL AND "project_delivery_version_items"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL AND char_length(btrim("project_delivery_version_items"."decision_note")) >= 10)
        OR ("project_delivery_version_items"."status" = 'DISPENSADO' AND "project_delivery_version_items"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL AND "project_delivery_version_items"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL AND char_length(btrim("project_delivery_version_items"."decision_note")) >= 10)
      )

eap_evidences_ticket_number_chk.name: eap_evidences_ticket_number_chk
eap_evidences_ticket_number_chk.value: CASE WHEN "eap_evidences"."kind" = 'GLPI_TICKET' THEN "eap_evidences"."ticket_number" IS NOT NULL AND "eap_evidences"."ticket_number" ~ '^[0-9]{1,12}$' ELSE "eap_evidences"."ticket_number" IS NULL END

eap_evidences_exactly_one_parent_chk.name: eap_evidences_exactly_one_parent_chk
eap_evidences_exactly_one_parent_chk.value:
(
        (CASE WHEN "eap_evidences"."phase_id" IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)
        + (CASE WHEN "eap_evidences"."task_id" IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)
        + (CASE WHEN "eap_evidences"."milestone_id" IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)
        + (CASE WHEN "eap_evidences"."schedule_request_id" IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)
        + (CASE WHEN "eap_evidences"."project_id" IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)
        + (CASE WHEN "eap_evidences"."project_result_id" IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)
      ) = 1

eap_impediments_resolution_chk.name: eap_impediments_resolution_chk
eap_impediments_resolution_chk.value:
(
        (
          "eap_impediments"."resolved_at" IS NULL
          AND "eap_impediments"."resolved_by" IS NULL
          AND "eap_impediments"."resolution_note" IS NULL
        ) OR (
          "eap_impediments"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "eap_impediments"."resolved_by" IS NOT NULL
          AND "eap_impediments"."resolved_at" >= "eap_impediments"."opened_at"
        )
      )

eap_milestone_deliveries_decision_chk.name: eap_milestone_deliveries_decision_chk
eap_milestone_deliveries_decision_chk.value:
(
        (
          "eap_milestone_deliveries"."status" = 'EM_ANALISE'
          AND "eap_milestone_deliveries"."decided_by" IS NULL
          AND "eap_milestone_deliveries"."decided_at" IS NULL
        ) OR (
          "eap_milestone_deliveries"."status" = 'ACEITA'
          AND "eap_milestone_deliveries"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL
          AND "eap_milestone_deliveries"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL
        ) OR (
          "eap_milestone_deliveries"."status" IN ('AJUSTES_SOLICITADOS', 'REJEITADA')
          AND "eap_milestone_deliveries"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL
          AND "eap_milestone_deliveries"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND char_length(btrim("eap_milestone_deliveries"."decision_note")) >= 10
        )
      )

eap_milestone_deliveries_resubmission_ch.name: eap_milestone_deliveries_resubmission_chk
eap_milestone_deliveries_resubmission_ch.value:
(
        "eap_milestone_deliveries"."resubmission_authorized_at" IS NULL
        AND "eap_milestone_deliveries"."resubmission_authorized_by" IS NULL
        AND "eap_milestone_deliveries"."resubmission_note" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "eap_milestone_deliveries"."status" = 'REJEITADA'
        AND "eap_milestone_deliveries"."resubmission_authorized_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "eap_milestone_deliveries"."resubmission_authorized_by" IS NOT NULL
        AND char_length(btrim("eap_milestone_deliveries"."resubmission_note")) >= 10
      )

eap_phases_planned_dates_chk.name: eap_phases_planned_dates_chk
eap_phases_planned_dates_chk.value: "eap_phases"."planned_end_at" IS NULL OR "eap_phases"."planned_start_at" IS NULL OR "eap_phases"."planned_end_at" >= "eap_phases"."planned_start_at"

eap_phases_baseline_dates_chk.name: eap_phases_baseline_dates_chk
eap_phases_baseline_dates_chk.value: "eap_phases"."baseline_end_at" IS NULL OR "eap_phases"."baseline_start_at" IS NULL OR "eap_phases"."baseline_end_at" >= "eap_phases"."baseline_start_at"

eap_phases_actual_dates_chk.name: eap_phases_actual_dates_chk
eap_phases_actual_dates_chk.value: "eap_phases"."actual_end_at" IS NULL OR ("eap_phases"."actual_start_at" IS NOT NULL AND "eap_phases"."actual_end_at" >= "eap_phases"."actual_start_at")

eap_schedule_changes_target_chk.name: eap_schedule_changes_target_chk
eap_schedule_changes_target_chk.value:
(
      (
        "eap_schedule_changes"."phase_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "eap_schedule_changes"."task_id" IS NULL
        AND "eap_schedule_changes"."milestone_id" IS NULL
        AND "eap_schedule_changes"."field" IN ('PLANNED_START_AT', 'PLANNED_END_AT')
      ) OR (
        "eap_schedule_changes"."phase_id" IS NULL
        AND "eap_schedule_changes"."task_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "eap_schedule_changes"."milestone_id" IS NULL
        AND "eap_schedule_changes"."field" IN ('PLANNED_START_AT', 'PLANNED_END_AT')
      ) OR (
        "eap_schedule_changes"."phase_id" IS NULL
        AND "eap_schedule_changes"."task_id" IS NULL
        AND "eap_schedule_changes"."milestone_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "eap_schedule_changes"."field" = 'PLANNED_AT'
      )
    )

eap_schedule_requests_target_chk.name: eap_schedule_requests_target_chk
eap_schedule_requests_target_chk.value:
(
      (
        "eap_schedule_requests"."phase_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "eap_schedule_requests"."task_id" IS NULL
        AND "eap_schedule_requests"."milestone_id" IS NULL
        AND "eap_schedule_requests"."field" IN ('PLANNED_START_AT', 'PLANNED_END_AT')
      ) OR (
        "eap_schedule_requests"."phase_id" IS NULL
        AND "eap_schedule_requests"."task_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "eap_schedule_requests"."milestone_id" IS NULL
        AND "eap_schedule_requests"."field" IN ('PLANNED_START_AT', 'PLANNED_END_AT')
      ) OR (
        "eap_schedule_requests"."phase_id" IS NULL
        AND "eap_schedule_requests"."task_id" IS NULL
        AND "eap_schedule_requests"."milestone_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "eap_schedule_requests"."field" = 'PLANNED_AT'
      )
    )

eap_schedule_requests_status_review_chk.name: eap_schedule_requests_status_review_chk
eap_schedule_requests_status_review_chk.value:
(
        (
          "eap_schedule_requests"."status" = 'PENDENTE'
          AND "eap_schedule_requests"."reviewed_by" IS NULL
          AND "eap_schedule_requests"."reviewed_at" IS NULL
          AND "eap_schedule_requests"."decision_note" IS NULL
        ) OR (
          "eap_schedule_requests"."status" = 'APROVADA'
          AND "eap_schedule_requests"."reviewed_by" IS NOT NULL
          AND "eap_schedule_requests"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL
        ) OR (
          "eap_schedule_requests"."status" = 'REJEITADA'
          AND "eap_schedule_requests"."reviewed_by" IS NOT NULL
          AND "eap_schedule_requests"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "eap_schedule_requests"."decision_note" IS NOT NULL
          AND char_length(btrim("eap_schedule_requests"."decision_note")) >= 10
        ) OR (
          "eap_schedule_requests"."status" = 'CANCELADA'
          AND "eap_schedule_requests"."reviewed_by" IS NULL
          AND "eap_schedule_requests"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL
        ) OR (
          "eap_schedule_requests"."status" = 'CANCELADA_CONFLITO'
          AND "eap_schedule_requests"."reviewed_by" IS NULL
          AND "eap_schedule_requests"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "eap_schedule_requests"."decision_note" IS NOT NULL
          AND char_length(btrim("eap_schedule_requests"."decision_note")) >= 10
        )
      )

project_executive_summary_validations_ob.value: ("project_executive_summary_validations"."kind" = 'REGULAR' OR ("project_executive_summary_validations"."observation" IS NOT NULL AND btrim("project_executive_summary_validations"."observation") <> '')) AND ("project_executive_summary_validations"."observation" IS NULL OR char_length("project_executive_summary_validations"."observation") <= 2000)

executive_followup_notifications_validat.name: executive_followup_notifications_validated_chk

notification_recipient_rules_target_chk.name: notification_recipient_rules_target_chk

notification_settings_enabled_chk.name: notification_settings_enabled_chk

project_profile_fields_published_complet.name: project_profile_fields_published_complete_chk
project_profile_fields_published_complet.value:
(
        ("project_profile_fields"."published_value" IS NULL) = ("project_profile_fields"."published_by" IS NULL)
        AND ("project_profile_fields"."published_value" IS NULL) = ("project_profile_fields"."published_at" IS NULL)
        AND ("project_profile_fields"."validated_by" IS NULL) = ("project_profile_fields"."validated_at" IS NULL)
        AND ("project_profile_fields"."validated_by" IS NULL OR "project_profile_fields"."published_value" IS NOT NULL)
      )

project_profile_fields_draft_complete_ch.name: project_profile_fields_draft_complete_chk
project_profile_fields_draft_complete_ch.value:
(
        (CASE WHEN "project_profile_fields"."draft_value" IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)
        + (CASE WHEN "project_profile_fields"."draft_by" IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)
        + (CASE WHEN "project_profile_fields"."draft_at" IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)
      ) IN (0, 3)

project_profile_fields_has_version_chk.name: project_profile_fields_has_version_chk
project_profile_fields_has_version_chk.value: "project_profile_fields"."published_value" IS NOT NULL OR "project_profile_fields"."draft_value" IS NOT NULL

project_profile_fields_text_chk.name: project_profile_fields_text_chk
project_profile_fields_text_chk.value:
("project_profile_fields"."published_value" IS NULL OR btrim("project_profile_fields"."published_value") <> '')
        AND ("project_profile_fields"."draft_value" IS NULL OR btrim("project_profile_fields"."draft_value") <> '')

project_results_published_complete_chk.name: project_results_published_complete_chk
project_results_published_complete_chk.value:
(

        AND ("project_results"."published_text" IS NULL) = ("project_results"."published_at" IS NULL)
        AND ("project_results"."validated_by" IS NULL) = ("project_results"."validated_at" IS NULL)
        AND ("project_results"."validated_by" IS NULL OR "project_results"."published_text" IS NOT NULL)
      )

project_results_correction_complete_chk.name: project_results_correction_complete_chk
project_results_correction_complete_chk.value:
(

        + (CASE WHEN "project_results"."correction_by" IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)
        + (CASE WHEN "project_results"."correction_at" IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)

project_results_draft_complete_chk.name: project_results_draft_complete_chk
project_results_draft_complete_chk.value:
(
        (CASE WHEN "project_results"."draft_text" IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)
        + (CASE WHEN "project_results"."draft_by" IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)
        + (CASE WHEN "project_results"."draft_at" IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)
      ) IN (0, 3)

project_results_has_version_chk.name: project_results_has_version_chk
project_results_has_version_chk.value: "project_results"."published_text" IS NOT NULL OR "project_results"."draft_text" IS NOT NULL

project_results_text_chk.name: project_results_text_chk
project_results_text_chk.value:
("project_results"."published_text" IS NULL OR btrim("project_results"."published_text") <> '')
        AND ("project_results"."draft_text" IS NULL OR btrim("project_results"."draft_text") <> '')

projects_planned_dates_chk.name: projects_planned_dates_chk
projects_planned_dates_chk.value: "projects"."planned_end_at" IS NULL OR "projects"."planned_start_at" IS NULL OR "projects"."planned_end_at" >= "projects"."planned_start_at"

projects_baseline_dates_chk.name: projects_baseline_dates_chk
projects_baseline_dates_chk.value: "projects"."baseline_end_at" IS NULL OR "projects"."baseline_start_at" IS NULL OR "projects"."baseline_end_at" >= "projects"."baseline_start_at"
